title: Heuristics

edits.reason: Intro teaches the green-dot pullback entry: 'Green Dots: seller exhaustion signal — potential long entry'. The pullback bottoms at leg-2 .to=95 (idx10), where the green dot (idx7) and 'Entry — Continue Uptrend' pin (idx8) sit. 95 is inside band [82,126]. Teal = long entry per palette. Drawing the entry as a LEVEL is the key concept of this illustration. REJECTED the auditor's second intro gap (markLine yAxis:126 'Trend Target'): its quote 'catch the MEAT of a trend' does not teach a 126 target level; 126 is the exact band ceiling (clip risk) and is already labelled by the existing 'Trend Target Achieved' pin at idx17 — redundant and an invented level on a concept chart.

This is the worked SHORT trade — entry and target most need to be drawn as levels. Entry: 'pull back into channel + exhaustion dot appears = enter in the direction of the HTF bias'; the rally peaks at leg-2 .to=100 (channel top, idx7 'Short Entry — With Trend' / idx6 red dot). yAxis:100 is inside band [72,108]; pink = short entry. Target: leg-3 .to=72 is where the 'Trend Target Achieved' pin (idx15) lands; yAxis:72 is the band floor and turns the pin into a drawn level. Target colored pink #ff2e88 to match the chapter's own convention (quiz revealMarkPoints label the bearish target in pink), rather than the auditor's teal which signals bullish/support and misreads a short's downside target. REJECTED the auditor's third gap (markLine yAxis:101.5 'Stop — above channel'): the text never names a stop price; 'Never trade dots against the channel direction' teaches signal invalidation, not a stop level — adding it would invent a level the lesson does not teach.

notes: Kept 2 of the auditor's 5 proposed gaps (intro long-entry level; lesson short-entry level), modified 1 (lesson short target re-colored teal->pink to match the chapter's existing bearish-target convention in quiz.revealMarkPoints), and rejected 2 (intro 'Trend Target' 126 — weak quote, band-ceiling clip risk, redundant with existing pin; lesson 'Stop' 101.5 — invented level the text never names). quiz.chart is correct as-is: cutIndex:8 keeps the pre-reveal to channel-zone decision context only, and revealMarkPoints route the rally/red-dot/target outcome post-answer with no spoiler. All proposed yAxis values verified inside their price bands (intro [82,126], lesson [72,108]).
